list.title: Revenue Recognition
list.description: Contracts, performance obligations, and recognition schedules (ASC 606).
list.emptyDescription: Post an invoice with a recognition-rule item to create obligations and schedules.

run.posted: Recognized {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} totaling {amount}

drawer.reconcileReason: Evidence the existing schedule was verified against
drawer.reconcilePlaceholder: Name the policy memo or records the schedule was checked against
drawer.reconciled: Legacy rule reconciled for this obligation

cancel.drawerHint: Ending this contract early? Cancel its recognition instead of voiding the invoice.
cancel.reasonPlaceholder: Describe why the remaining obligation is being cancelled
cancel.confirmBody: Posted recognition entries will be reversed, the remaining plan retired, and invoice {invoice} voided. This cannot be undone.

review.title: Run recognition
review.description: Review the exact entries before anything posts.
review.asOfHint: Lines due on or before this date. Defaults to today.
review.willPost: {count, plural, one {# line posts} other {# lines post}}
review.willSkip: {count, plural, one {# line held back} other {# lines held back}}
review.scopeChanged: The scope changed since this preview. Refresh before confirming.
review.nothingDue: Nothing due to recognize as of {date}
review.stale: The reviewed set changed. Preview again, then confirm.
review.errScope: That scope is no longer available. Reopen the drawer.

modify.title: Modify {number}
modify.description: The original journals remain. Submit this assessment for independent approval before changing the allocation.
modify.rateLabel: {book}: recognition exchange rate (contract to functional currency)
modify.treatSeparate: Additional distinct promises at SSP — separate contract
modify.consideration: Change in consideration (negative for a reduction)
modify.distinct: Remaining / added goods or services are distinct from those transferred
modify.commensurate: Added promises are priced commensurately with standalone selling prices
modify.affected: Existing promises affected by this group
modify.omittedHint: An affected promise omitted below ends at its earned-to-date amount. Add a group for each distinctness treatment in a mixed amendment.
modify.rights: Evidence of the parties’ enforceable amendment
modify.assessment: Distinctness, price, progress and historical exchange-rate assessment
modify.proposeFailed: Contract modification could not be proposed
